product.name: Pinzon Capitola Center Glass Dining Table
product.description: Beautiful, eye-catching dining table is durably crafted and versatile Solid birch frame and ash veneer top have a warm brown Cosmo finish Frosted glass inset measures 22-3/4 inches square; table holds up to 200 pounds Coordinates with the Pinzon Capitola Dining Collection Measures 60 inches wide by 60 inches deep by 30 inches high
